"About 200 years ago in England, I was born in a cold, harsh workhouse (a poorhouse for very poor people) 🏚️. My mother (Agnes) died soon after giving birth 😢. No one knew my father's name. The mean workhouse officer, Mr Bumble, named me Oliver Twist 👶. I am a poor orphan (a child with no parents), and my life in this cold place is just beginning..."

📖 Oliver's Friends & Foes (13 Key Characters)

👶🥣 1. Oliver Twist
Main Hero

A kind, gentle orphan boy. He suffers much cruelty but always stays good and honest.

🎩📚 2. Mr Brownlow
Kind Friend

A kind, rich old gentleman. He rescues Oliver and later adopts him like a son.

🧔‍♂️👛 3. Fagin
Villain Gang

An old, clever criminal. He trains young boys to pickpocket and hoard stolen goods.

🎩🦊 4. The Artful Dodger
Fagin's Gang

Real name: Jack Dawkins. A smart, cheerful boy who brings Oliver to Fagin's house.

🔫😠 5. Bill Sikes
Dangerous Villain

A cruel, violent burglar with a bad temper. He forces Oliver into a house burglary.

🧣🌉 6. Nancy
Secret Helper

Works for Fagin and Sikes, but feels sorry for Oliver and secretly sacrifices her life to save him.

🕵️‍♂️💰 7. Monks (Edward Leeford)
Evil Half-Brother

Oliver's half-brother. He wants to ruin Oliver so Oliver will lose their father's inheritance money.

👮‍♂️🏚️ 8. Mr Bumble
Workhouse Boss

The selfish and proud beadle (officer) of the workhouse. He treats poor children badly.

💍🍵 9. Mrs Corney (Mrs Bumble)
Workhouse Matron

The greedy matron of the workhouse. She marries Mr Bumble and sells Agnes's gold locket to Monks.

⚰️🔨 10. Mr Sowerberry
Undertaker

The undertaker who makes coffins and takes Oliver in as a young apprentice.

🤥👀 11. Noah Claypole
Bully & Spy

A big bully at the coffin shop. Later he joins Fagin and spies on Nancy on London Bridge.

🌹💛 12. Rose Maylie
Kind Aunt

A gentle, kind young lady who nurses wounded Oliver. She is actually Oliver's aunt!

🏡❤️ 13. Mrs Maylie
Kind Helper

Rose's kind adoptive mother. She protects and cares for Oliver after the failed burglary.
